sanskrit_verse:
व्यवहाराश्रितं प्रश्नं पृच्छति प्राड् इति श्रुतिः ।
विवदेत तत्र यस तस्मिन् प्राड्विवाकस तु स स्मृतः ॥
transliteration: vyavahārāśritaṃ praśnaṃ pṛcchati prāḍ iti śrutiḥ | vivadet tatra yaḥ tasmin prāḍvivākaḥ tu saḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who inquires into a matter of transactional conflict with clarity and completeness, as declared by the Vedas, and engages fully in its resolution, is recognized as a Prāḍvivāka—established in the capacity of conscious adjudication.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from completeness of inquiry, not institutional position.
Causation arises through conscious engagement with the factual substratum.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one's ability to sustain clarity in conflict-resolution.
Restoration logic requires full reintegration into the truth-body of the dispute.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent initiates inquiry into vyavahāra (transactional conflict) AND sustains prāḍ-level clarity throughout THEN that agent assumes Prāḍvivāka status.
IF Prāḍvivāka status is attained THEN all disputants must align with the consciousness-field established by that agent.
IF resolution is incomplete THEN re-entry into inquiry phase is mandatory until restoration is achieved.
IF no agent attains prāḍ-level clarity THEN automated Nyaya protocols shall activate to restore inquiry capacity.
supreme_court_application: In the Supreme Court of Dharma, only those who demonstrate prāḍ-level inquiry and maintain unbroken clarity during vyavahāra engagement are authorized to adjudicate. Institutional rank holds no precedence over consciousness-readiness. All judgments must reflect restoration of integrity rather than enforcement of rulings.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that true resolution arises only when consciousness is aligned with the factual substratum. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential unfolding of truth without punitive overlays. Responsibility is proportional to one’s capacity to sustain clarity. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering has no place in authentic judicial process.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Prāḍ Inquiry Completion Cycle to ensure no factual layer remains unresolved.
Activate Consciousness Re-alignment Protocol for all involved parties until integrity resonance is restored.
Deploy Responsibility Assumption Matrix to verify each agent’s capacity to uphold dharma in the case.
Reintegrate all participants into Unified Truth Field through Nyāyic Recalibration Ritual.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Dharma is restored. Justice is non-punitive. Consciousness is the sole adjudicator. Reality aligns with completeness.
